No evidence of reinventing something the ecosystem already solves in the files reviewed.

Ran the real unit suite (evidence/vitest-az-planting-calendar.txt): 15 files, 114 tests, all passing. Reviewed the sampled files: coverage.test.ts exercises real inputs (matchOutOfCoveragePlace, filterZones) with both hit and miss cases, not tautologies; schemas.test.ts and halfMonth.test.ts cover boundary values (half-month 0/23, invalid dates). acceptance.spec.ts adds 1070 lines of Playwright coverage for the primary flow, grid scrolling, crop citations and API 404 handling -- not a token smoke test.

acceptance.spec.ts tests user-visible behaviour, not implementation details: it uses page.waitForResponse to wait on the real network call before asserting (lines 48-52, 77-79, 98-100, 115-117), asserts via getByTestId/getByRole rather than scraping markup, and the 404 test (lines 15-31) uses a random path suffix specifically so a cached or previously-seeded route cannot satisfy it by accident -- a deliberate defence against a false pass, not a snapshot of current output.
